name: get_order_status
description: Look up one of the signed-in dealer's or builder's steel orders by order number (format TSO-YY-NNNNNN). Returns product, grade, size, tonnes, order date, status and status note.

name: track_dispatch
description: Track a dispatched truck by lorry receipt (LR) number (format JSR-LR-NNNNNN). Returns order number, truck number, route, dispatch date, ETA, status, and the e-way bill number and validity.

name: get_invoice
description: Fetch one of the signed-in customer's Tata Steel tax invoices by invoice number (format TSL/JSR/YY-YY/NNNNNN). Returns quantity, rate, taxable value, GST, total, IRN, e-way bill number, due date and payment status.

name: get_test_certificate
description: Get the mill test certificate (MTC) for a heat number on the signed-in customer's own orders. Returns grade, size, chemical analysis (C, S, P, S+P, CE), mechanical results (yield, tensile, TS/YS ratio, elongation, Agt), bend/rebend result and conformity to IS 1786.

heatNo.description: Heat number from the bundle tag, e.g. J24K42210

name: get_vendor_payment
description: For signed-in suppliers: status of a supplier invoice raised on Tata Steel, by the supplier's own invoice number. Returns PO number, acceptance date, due date (45 days from acceptance for MSMEs), amount, status, hold reason, and payment date and UTR if paid.
